_provenance: This is NOT a literal, unmodified JSON.stringify(window.__hidLog) dump copied out of the browser -- an earlier attempt at that (hand-transcribing the full 64-byte hex strings) introduced a real, undetected bug (every 0x40/0x41 OUT report was one padding byte short) that shipped in this PR's first version. To eliminate that entire class of error, this file's meaningful bytes (opcode, reserved, length, checksum, status, and the actual non-padding payload) were re-verified against the session's live capture output (quoted directly, not re-derived), and the trailing zero-padding to 64 bytes was computed programmatically rather than hand-typed -- see scripts/build-fixtures.js, which generates fixtures/cap1.json from these exact same 12 entries. The checksum bytes here are the REAL values the device echoed back in its own ACK during capture, not values computed from the checksum formula -- scripts/check-coverage.js independently recomputes the expected checksum and asserts it matches these real observed bytes, which is the actual point of committing this file: an evidence chain the CI checks are not just checking against themselves.
captured: 2026-08-10, single 'Update device time' click, one representative instance of each of the 12 distinct report/ACK pairs sent (the full transaction sends 3 identical repeats of each -- see fixtures/cap3.json's repeat_structure for that count, independently confirmed)
